title: Statistics of Matrix Elements of Operators in a Disorder-Free SYK model
summary: Recently, studies have explored the statistics of matrix elements of local operators in the Lieb-Liniger model. It was found that the probability distribution function for off-diagonal matrix elements $\langle \boldsymbolμ|\mathcal{O}|\boldsymbolλ \rangle$ within the same macro-state is well described by the Fréchet distributions. This represents a significant development for the Eigenstate Thermalization Hypothesis (ETH).
